rows.grounds: compound epithet: tarka (reasoning) + adhyāpana (instruction) + madhya (middle) + sthā (abiding); feminine nominative singular
compound epithet: tarka (reasoning) + adhyāpana (instruction) + kāriṇī (doer/performer); feminine nominative singular

items.question: In what manner does the goddess preside over and enact the teaching of logic?
premises: The goddess abides at the center of logical instruction.
The goddess actively performs the teaching of logic.
Both epithets attribute authoritative involvement in reasoning to her.
items.inference: The goddess is both the central locus and the active agent of logical instruction.
uncertainties: The specific ritual or doctrinal context of logical instruction is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: She abides at the center of teaching logic and is the one who carries out the teaching of logic.
